:::{#def-non-decreasing}
#### Non-decreasing sequence

A [sequence](functions.qmd#def-sequence) $a_1, a_2, \ldots$
of [real numbers](number-systems.qmd#def-real-numbers) or of [extended non-negative reals](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-extended-nonneg-reals)
is **non-decreasing**
if each term is at least as large as the one before it:

$$a_n \le a_{n+1} \quad \text{for every } n \in \Nat$$

:::
